description: Land Title Settlement Department - Lunuwila, Wennappuwa D/S Division, Puttalam District - Cad. Map No. 410008
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, block numbers, cadastral map references, and owner details) in various villages. The content focuses on land ownership, title settlements, and property rights, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
